integrity: The arbitrary-r forcing criterion uses an inclusion-minimal white type and its complementary Boolean type; rank uses an exact unimodular Boolean quotient; parameter recovery uses exact subset-product multiset inversion with repetitions.
scientific_limitations: Every local factor is assumed to be a nonfield.
The polynomial recovers local proper-ideal counts, not local ring isomorphism types.
For chain-ring factors the recovered counts equal nilpotency lengths.
Minimum rank is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
Generic type compression for zero forcing polynomials has broader prior coverage.
title: Zero forcing polynomials completely recognize fully nonfield co-maximal ideal graphs
